phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Capacitive soil moisture sensor probe integrated with a microcontroller unit (MCU) and wireless radio module for in-situ soil moisture measurement and remote data transmission in precision agriculture.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: This configuration represents the industry-standard sensor device widely adopted in agriculture for its accuracy, low power consumption, and wireless connectivity. The integration of capacitive sensing with an MCU and radio is common for autonomous soil monitoring systems with IoT-enabled data access.
